onboarding.welcome:
Spill the tea.
Learn the history.
onboarding.q1Title:
How much history
do you actually know?
onboarding.q1Comment1: Perfect — History Tea makes it easy to jump in. No textbooks, no dates to memorize, just press play.
onboarding.q1Comment2: Great start! You'll hear the stories behind the stories you already know.
onboarding.q1Comment3: You're going to love how we tell these. Same events, none of the dry textbook energy.
onboarding.q1Comment4: Then you already know history is the best soap opera ever written. Welcome home.
onboarding.q2Title:
What brings you to
History Tea?
onboarding.q2Comment1: You're in the right place — short audio stories you can listen to anytime, anywhere.
onboarding.q2Comment2: From Cleopatra to Genghis Khan to Napoleon — history's most chaotic personalities, all in one place.
onboarding.q2Comment3: One story a day. Track your streak, build consistency, become the most interesting person in any room.
onboarding.q2Comment4: Honestly the most respectable use of an app. You'll have a wild fact for every occasion.
onboarding.q2Comment5: Curiosity is how every great historian started. Let's show you what History Tea is all about.
onboarding.feature1:
History like you've
never heard it told
onboarding.feature2:
Every era, every legend —
all in one place
onboarding.feature3:
The past, finally
in your language
onboarding.reviewsTitle: Don't just take our word for it
onboarding.review1: I never thought I'd binge history on my commute. This app changed that.
onboarding.review2: The narrators actually make you feel like you're IN the room when Caesar gets stabbed. Obsessed.
onboarding.rateReview: I put this on during my morning walk and now I know more about Genghis Khan than I ever needed to. Worth it.
